verification_report.summary: The submitted supplement is correct under the stated canonical inputs. The audit independently checks the rank-one wedge algebra, the Gauduchon condition and minimizing assertion, the normalization I_epsilon, all four smooth (2,2)-form limits and annihilation identities, the exact determinant denominator and epsilon^(q/3) exponent, the coefficient-matrix ranks, the edge blow-up and vertex behavior of roots, and the distinction between this smooth fixed-density family and the varying-density/full-cone lower-mass sequence. The rank-two boundary form is correctly not assigned a finite semipositive (1,1) square root; the eigenvalue/cofactor rank argument is the appropriate boundary argument.
